prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. Five adult friends aged 26 to 40 gather around a seated birthday friend in a modest apartment, smiling and clapping as a small candle-lit cake is placed on the table. Everyone reacts differently rather than posing in a row. Use warm lamps with remaining window light, natural skin tones, and an environmental composition. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearances: the seated birthday friend is a woman with a short ash-blond bob and a round face; her five friends are a slim dark-curly-haired man with glasses, a broad ginger-haired man, a copper-curly-haired woman with freckles, a tall black-haired woman in a low bun, and a stocky sandy-haired man. Exactly six adults in total; distinct faces, ages and realistic body types. Keep candles clear of hands and faces.
Composition priority: exact wide 16:9 aspect ratio. Step the camera back to an environmental medium-wide view. ALL main people, faces, arms, hands and key props must fit entirely in the central 55 percent of image width, leaving substantial believable room or scenery at BOTH sides.
Use one uninterrupted coherent photograph: never dissolve any body, clothing, person or object into the background; no synthetic gradient overlays, crossfades, erased limbs or blended horizontal bands.
review: Reviewed full wide image: exactly six distinct adults celebrate a seated blond birthday woman, with five friends smiling and clapping around a small candlelit cake. All six faces and main hand gestures are coherent and remain intact in the central 4:3 and 1.65:1 crops; side room context can be trimmed without losing the action. Horizontal 1672x941.
